description: This file defines a React component called Divider, which is a draggable UI element used within a dashboard layout. It includes styling, delete functionality, and drag-and-drop capabilities.

classes.name: Divider
classes.description: A React component representing a draggable divider line in a dashboard layout.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Divider component and binds the handleDeleteComponent method.

methods.name: handleDeleteComponent
methods.description: Handles the deletion of the component by invoking the deleteComponent prop with the component's id and parentId.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the draggable divider element, including optional delete button in edit mode.
